event_summary: A gray round disk moves through a triangular wheeled frame, reaches the floor, and then rolls rightward away from the frame while the frame shifts slightly left.
raw_event_description: At the start, a gray circular disk is visible hanging by a thin white line inside a triangular frame made of pale rods with red wheels. The disk moves downward and rightward through the frame, passes near the front lower rods and right-side wheel area, reaches the floor, and then continues rightward on the floor as a rolling upright disk. During the later part, the wheeled frame remains in view on the left and appears slightly farther left relative to the floor markings, while the disk separates from the frame area and travels to the right before slowing near the right side of the view.

reasons: The gray disk, thin line, triangular rod frame, red wheels, and floor are visible.
The upper attachment point of the thin line is outside or near the top edge of the frame.
Some parts of the wheeled structure extend beyond the left edge of the image.
